g.text: Red connector, under steering column above pedals.
Connects to OVMS module DB9 port.
Red connector, extension end. Pins 1:1 with black J533 connector.
Part: 8E0972420 (male+female kit). Pins 2 and 4 not used.
• Twisted pair: CAN (−/+ of same bus). Extension: 1:1, 18 wires
● Double-crimped pin: tap to DB9 + extension
Factory wiring: 0.35 mm² (≈ 22 AWG), power and CAN.
Recommended: 0.35 mm² (22 AWG) stranded for all wires.
